theme: An open day with the trip's loose ends to tie off.
greeting: The calendar's wide open, Dan — nothing scheduled today or tomorrow. What's live is all trip logistics, and a couple of windows close in the next day or two.

needsAttention.title: St Pete stay locks in Sept 18
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete Airbnb ($2,331) charges tomorrow — last day to swap for a better option, and worth confirming the pending booking actually converted rather than lapsing.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends midday Sat Sept 19 at Komolac. The transfer to Cavtat, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and the ~5:15 AM Sunday checkout for the 7:30 flight all still need arranging while you have signal.

needsAttention.title: Tampa car for the 20th
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun Sept 20 at 3:55 PM with no car booked yet — the full-size SUV for Sept 20–Oct 5 wants booking before you're at a Sunday walk-up counter.

flagged.title: Revolut account is live
flagged.detail: Your new Revolut account is verified, a card's on the way, and a $366.63 payment to Mladen Franic went through today.

flagged.title: Governance networking thread
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano and Chie Mitsui are lining up a Mercer/Marsh intro around the Independent Managers Club — you're cc'd, nothing owed yet.

flagged.title: LinkedIn role alerts
flagged.detail: A batch of LinkedIn job alerts came through (a VP listing among them) — a quick scan when you have a minute.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
